methodology_note: India Hate Lab Annual Report 2023. 668 verified in-person anti-Muslim (and to a lesser extent anti-Christian) hate speech events. India Hate Lab Report 2023 (executive summary, cross-cited by The Quint, CJP, Vartha Bharati). Methodology: IHL counts hate speech events (rallies, political speeches, religious gatherings with hateful rhetoric) — fundamentally a different unit than NCRB's 'communal rioting incidents' (police-registered IPC violations). Read side-by-side, not combined.
